name: Repositories
responsibility: repo list, add, use, forget and language-server: the checkouts bindings resolve to, the chosen one for each repository, and the language servers that a repository or this machine names
description: Keeps this machine's checkout registry. repo add registers a checkout, with the worktrees git lists for it, or an untracked vault, and never changes which checkout of a repository is chosen. A checkout whose identity is an untracked vault's name keeps it, and the answer's renamed gives the vault's new name. repo use chooses one. repo forget removes one; list shows each, chosen or gone. None of them calls a server: every running server watches the registry file. language-server, in language-server.ts beside it, shows, sets and removes the servers of the working directory's checkout in its committed .archboard/language-servers.json, of the chosen checkout that --repo names, or of this machine with --global; the registry holds no servers.

outgoing.label: register its checkout; choose and forget checkouts
show and write a repository's or this machine's servers
